study type: secondary analysis of a prospective observational study
exposure: levator hiatal dimensions (at rest, with maximum Valsalva, during pelvic floor muscle contraction)
outcome: individual sexual complaints (desire, arousal, orgasm, dyspareunia)
cohort: Two hundred four women who had a first, spontaneous vaginal delivery at term between 2012 and 2015 were recruited.
finding: After first vaginal delivery, sexual dysfunction was not significantly associated with levator hiatal dimensions as measured by 4D transperineal ultrasound.
